    condition = BUILD_DATE != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'BUILD_DATE' must not be empty."
  }
}

target "buster-1-0-0-build" {
  dockerfile = "foo/Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BAR_VERSION = "Zm9vCg=="
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "buster"
    FOO_BAR_VERSION = "1.0.0"
    NODEJS_VERSION = "14.17.3"
  }
  secret = [
    {
      type = "env"
      id = "GITHUB_TOKEN"
    },
    {
      type = "file"
      id = "aws"
      src = "${HOME}/.aws/credentials"
    },
  ]
  platforms = ["linux/amd64"]
  output    = [{ type = "docker" }]
  tags      = ["foo-bar/1.0.0/buster:${BUILD_DATE}"]
}
